description:
Celebrating Durga Puja in Kolkata: A Journey of Faith and Fellowship
Our Rotary fellowship specially all women trip to Kolkata celebrated devotion, culture, and togetherness, with mandap hopping and Durga Maa darshan at its heart. Beautifully decorated mandaps and the city's festive spirit made every visit memorable.
Heartfelt thanks to our Fellowship Director, Sumit Daruka, and Rachana Daruka for their thoughtful planning, comfortable stay, delicious food, and smooth arrangements. Special thanks to Mamta for arranging Durga Maa darshan.
The laughter, warm conversations, and cheerful company of all our wonderful women added joy to the journey and strengthened the bonds of our Rotary family.
We returned with grateful hearts, deeper friendships, and cherished memories—a beautiful celebration of faith and fellowship!
